note: Known product defects found by code verification. Rendered into docs/FEATURE-STATUS.md §6. Security findings stay in docs/AUDIT-2026-10-20.md.

defects.title: Plans still seeded in USD but formatted as NGN
defects.impact: Every plan renders the dollar-era figure as naira — Premium Single shows ₦2 for 365 days, Package ₦20 — and Paystack would charge exactly that. Blocked on Q2–Q6.
defects.fix: Checkout guard added: a non-zero price below ₦1,000 is treated as a placeholder, so the plan renders "Pricing under review" + "Enquire" and cannot be bought. Real NGN figures in plans.price flip it back on with no deploy.

defects.title: Firm/law-firm gallery cap not enforced server-side; chamber gallery unvalidated
defects.impact: Free users can exceed gallery caps via the chamber form.
defects.fix: Firm gallery cap now applied server-side (chamber role or chamber_id); the chamber form writes through a server action that clamps the gallery, gates the intro video and checks chamber_admin membership.

defects.title: Silver plan rows are ₦0 with no features
defects.impact: The pricing page advertises an empty middle tier.
defects.fix: Fill features + price once Tobi answers Q8 (C21 contents).

defects.title: Corporate-posts Basic tier shipped on the ₦100 test price
defects.impact: Every Corporate Posts surface advertised ₦100, and Paystack would have charged ₦100 for the Basic tier.
defects.fix: Set Basic to ₦100,000 in lib/corporate-posts.json (price + formatted_price) and dropped the "TEST PRICE" description. Deployed and verified in the live HTML.

defects.title: Bookmark affordance absent from cards
defects.impact: 'Saved Lawyers' is only usable from a profile page.
defects.fix: LawyerCard renders BookmarkButton when signed in, on both grid and list variants; the list variant stops click propagation so bookmarking does not navigate.

defects.title: Dead Calendly state/type fields after UI removal
defects.impact: Dead code; misleads future readers into thinking Calendly is supported.
defects.fix: Removed the leftover calendly_url field from LawyerForm state and the public profile type.

defects.title: Three empty dashboard dirs (chat, wallet, packages)
defects.impact: Harmless, but suggests shipped features; no nav links point at them.
defects.fix: Deleted the empty dashboard directories (chat, wallet, packages) so no nav-less shells imply shipped features.

defects.title: No admin analytics route
defects.impact: Tier 5 telemetry (signups, subscribers, revenue, funnel) is blocked.
defects.fix: Build app/admin/analytics on top of getAdminStats + revenue queries.

defects.title: Error boundaries on only two routes
defects.impact: Admin and dashboard failures fall through to the root boundary.
defects.fix: Added route-level error boundaries at app/admin/error.tsx and app/directory/dashboard/error.tsx, so admin and dashboard failures no longer fall through to the root boundary.

defects.title: Category filtering used `.eq()` on a TEXT[] column — every category page 400'd and rendered empty
defects.impact: `/insights?category=*` and `/category/*` returned 404/empty because PostgREST rejected `category=eq.news` with "malformed array literal". Corporate Posts were invisible for the same reason.
defects.fix: Added `categoryCandidates()` and switched every category filter to `.overlaps()` (&&), matching both slug and label spellings. Verified on prod data: news 1000+, opinions 235, judgements 30, sports-law 6, corporate-post 2.

defects.title: Corporate Posts listing fetched the 50 newest articles then filtered in JS
defects.impact: Any burst of ordinary published articles pushed Corporate Posts off the listing entirely.
defects.fix: Filter server-side with `article_type = corporate_post` via the new `articleType` option on `getPublishedArticles()`.

defects.title: Email verification links land signed-out (PKCE code / implicit hash)
defects.impact: Confirmation links went to GoTrue /auth/v1/verify, which redirects with ?code= (needs the code-verifier cookie, so it fails on a phone) or #access_token (a fragment no route can read). Users were verified but signed out.
defects.fix: Added lib/auth/confirm.ts using verifyOtp({type, token_hash}) — no cookie needed — served at /auth/confirm on both hosts; the hook now mails that link and keeps ?next=. Verified live: session cookie set, redirect to /search.
